newsitem.title: USA: Damen Financial begins share buyback offer.
newsitem.headline: Damen Financial begins share buyback offer.

text.p: Damen Financial Corp said it began its offer to repurchase up to 850,000 shares of its common stock, which represents 22.5 percent of its 3,770,117 outstanding shares.

The repurchase will be made through a modified Dutch auction tender. Under this procedure, Damen Financial stockholders will be given the opportunity to sell part or all of their shares to the corporation at a price of not less than $13.25 a share and not more than $14.75 a share.
This price range represents a 1.9 percent discount to a 9.3 percent premium to the February 13, 1997, closing price of $13.50 per share.

Based upon the minimum and maximum offering prices specified in the offer, the aggregate purchase price, if 850,000 shares were purchased, would range from approximately $11.3 million to $12.5 million.
The offer to purchase shares will expire on March 27, unless extended by Damen Financial.
